composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. creative_direction: Create a covered timber bridge after light rain. Set the bridge entrance in the lower center, with a simple pitched roof and evenly spaced timber posts. Use cinematic architectural painting. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
